t: BWT Power Crystals Central Heating System Cleaner offers a quick and effective solution for all wet central heating systems. These powerful crystals provide the cleaning strength of a liquid in a convenient sachet, making them ideal for intensive cleaning tasks. They are designed to remove debris, sludge, and scale from both new and existing closed loop systems, helping to restore heating system efficiency and reduce boiler noise. This makes them a valuable asset for plumbers and heating engineers maintaining domestic and commercial properties.
